rationale: C11 plausibly supplied a material drafting template for the child. Both letters summarize Executive Branch study and implementation of Second Hoover Commission recommendations, assess progress already achieved while emphasizing that further work remains, anticipate additional action, and close by praising the Commission's contribution to improved government. The unusually close progression and repeated language about recommendations, actions taken, encouragement at accomplishments thus far, further progress, and Executive Branch cooperation exceed general topical similarity. C16 and C08 share the same Hoover Commission implementation context and some phrasing, but are narrower responses concerning Defense and budget/accounting respectively.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The Departments and Agencies of the Executive Branch have completed a thoroughgoing study of the recommendations applicable to them
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The reports ... headed by former President Herbert Hoover have been the subject of extensive study in the Executive Branch of the Government.
shared_material.explanation: Both frame the status update around comprehensive Executive Branch study of Hoover Commission recommendations.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am encouraged by what seems to me to be a satisfactory degree of progress, but obviously a great deal more needs to be done.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I am encouraged by what has been accomplished thus far and am eager to see to it that we make further progress as rapidly as possible.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive parallel assessment: encouragement over accomplishments to date followed immediately by insistence on further progress.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I propose to transmit further specific legislative proposals to the next session of the Congress
shared_material.parent_excerpt: In making recommendations to the Congress, the Executive Branch should consider these proposals carefully
shared_material.explanation: Both move from administrative review and implementation to contemplated congressional recommendations, though the child's formulation is broader.

shared_material.child_excerpt: there will be increasing recognition of the great contribution made by your Commission
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The Commission report on Personnel and Civil Service makes an important contribution to this objective.
shared_material.explanation: Both conclude by characterizing the Commission's recommendations as an important contribution to better government.
